name: Variational Bayes Gaussian Splatting
definition: A method for training Gaussian splats by framing it as variational inference over model parameters, leveraging conjugacy properties of multivariate Gaussians to derive closed-form update rules for continual learning without replay buffers.
summary: Variational Bayes Gaussian Splatting is a training method that frames 3D Gaussian Splatting optimization as variational inference, enabling continual learning without catastrophic forgetting.
